game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the frozen well.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the frozen well. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vault value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the frozen well using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the frozen well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 22.
